payload.prompt: Registrer 29 timer for Silje Bakken (silje.bakken@example.org) på aktiviteten "Analyse" i prosjektet "Nettbutikk-utvikling" for Polaris AS (org.nr 860142015). Timesats: 1950 kr/t. Generer en prosjektfaktura til kunden basert på de registrerte timene.

payload.goal: Register 29 hours for Silje Bakken on activity "Analyse" in project "Nettbutikk-utvikling" for customer Polaris AS and generate a project invoice based on those hours.
success_checks: Employee Silje Bakken exists with email silje.bakken@example.org
Customer Polaris AS exists with organization number 860142015
Project "Nettbutikk-utvikling" exists and is linked to Polaris AS
A timesheet entry for 29 hours is registered for Silje Bakken on the project/activity
A project invoice is created for Polaris AS based on the registered hours
Invoice line reflects 29 hours at 1950 kr/t
risk_notes: No work date or period specified for the 29 hours; timesheet registration may require a date
Sandbox is empty, so employee, customer, and project must be created first
Project invoice flow may require project-to-customer linkage and billable settings
VAT rate is not explicitly stated; invoice VAT may need configuration or default handling
No invoice send instruction was given, only generate/create invoice
ordered_steps: POST /customer -> create customer Polaris AS with organization number 860142015
POST /employee -> create employee Silje Bakken with email silje.bakken@example.org
POST /project -> create project "Nettbutikk-utvikling" linked to customer Polaris AS and mark as billable
POST /timesheet or /project/{projectId}/timesheet -> register 29 hours for Silje Bakken on activity "Analyse" (requires work date/period)
POST /order -> create order for customer Polaris AS tied to project "Nettbutikk-utvikling"
POST /order/{orderId}/lines -> add billable time line for 29 hours at 1950 excluding VAT if required by invoice flow
POST /invoice -> generate project invoice for Polaris AS based on registered project hours/order lines
GET /invoice/{invoiceId} -> verify invoice contains 29 hours at 1950 kr/t and is linked to the correct customer/project
